create_identity_channel: create an IdentityChannel instance to pass messages between server and client without modification
send_client_to_server: send a Message from client to server using the IdentityChannel client_to_server method
send_server_to_client: send a Message from server to client using the IdentityChannel server_to_client method
calculate_model_size: calculate the model size in bytes from a state dict using calc_model_size_float_point
customize_channel_lifecycle: customize channel behavior by overriding lifecycle hooks like _on_client_before_transmission in a subclass
